badge.titleLine.description: Toolbar icon tooltip after a send, when the outcome has two parts. {headline} is the first sentence (e.g. “Sent to Pixel 9”) and {detail} the second (e.g. “Opens when it wakes”). The full stop after {headline} is part of this message.

badge.unreadOverflow.description: Text on the toolbar icon when more than 9 received tabs have not been looked at yet. At most 4 characters; the icon is tiny.
